fusions.name: Forged Seal
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 15% chance to turn it against its own allies for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Rumour Spreads
fusions.desc: A cone 4 tiles long that deals 11 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each [Damped] for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Blame Laid Elsewhere
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Thumb on the Scale
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands. The effect increases by 8% for each ally within 5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
